example.t: Enzymes in our cells catalyse the chemical reactions that keep the whole body functioning properly every day.
example.zh: 我们细胞中的酶催化着维持整个身体每天正常运转的化学反应。

example.t: Bacteria can proliferate rapidly in warm, moist environments where food and moisture are plentiful all year round.
example.zh: 细菌在温暖潮湿、食物和水分全年充足的环境中能迅速增殖。

example.t: Thick lead shields attenuate the harmful radiation that escapes from the reactor core during an accident.
example.zh: 厚厚的铅屏蔽层能减弱事故期间从反应堆堆芯逸出的有害辐射。

example.t: Planting trees along the coast can mitigate the damage caused by storms and rising sea levels.
example.zh: 沿海种植树木可以减轻风暴和海平面上升造成的破坏。

example.t: Cutting down forests will only exacerbate the problem of global warming in the long run.
example.zh: 从长远来看，砍伐森林只会加剧全球变暖的问题。

example.t: Oil prices remain highly volatile because sudden political events can change global supply overnight.
example.zh: 油价仍然高度不稳定，因为突发的政治事件可能一夜之间改变全球供应。

meaning_zh: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的

example.t: Coral reefs are surprisingly resilient and can recover if the water cools again quickly.
example.zh: 珊瑚礁的恢复力出人意料地强，如果水温再次迅速下降，它们就能恢复。

example.t: Plastic bags dumped into the sea take hundreds of years to degrade completely, harming wildlife.
example.zh: 被倒入海里的塑料袋需要数百年才能完全降解，还会危害野生动物。

example.t: Industrial waste can contaminate nearby rivers and make the water unsafe for local residents.
example.zh: 工业废料会污染附近的河流，使水对当地居民来说不宜饮用。

example.t: Chemists can now synthesize the active ingredient of the drug safely in large quantities.
example.zh: 化学家如今能够安全地大量合成这种药物的有效成分。

example.t: The scan showed that the growth was benign and required no immediate further treatment.
example.zh: 扫描显示这个肿块是良性的，不需要进一步治疗。

example.t: He felt acute pain in his chest and was rushed to the hospital immediately.
example.zh: 他感到胸口剧烈疼痛，被立刻送往医院。

example.t: Millions of people live with chronic conditions that require daily medication and regular check-ups.
example.zh: 数百万人患有慢性病，需要每日服药并定期检查。

example.t: A strong immune system helps the body fight off infections before they become serious.
example.zh: 强大的免疫系统能帮助身体在感染变得严重之前将其击退。

meaning_zh: 无处不在的；普遍存在的

example.t: Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that it is hard to imagine life without them.
example.zh: 智能手机已经变得如此无处不在，很难想象没有它们的生活。

example.t: Many jobs may become obsolete as machines take over tasks once done by hand.
example.zh: 随着机器接管曾是手工完成的活儿，许多工作可能会变得过时。

example.t: The search engine uses a complex algorithm to rank pages according to their relevance and popularity.
example.zh: 这个搜索引擎使用复杂的算法，根据相关性和受欢迎程度对网页进行排序。

example.t: Banks encrypt sensitive data so that hackers cannot read it if it is stolen.
example.zh: 银行对敏感数据加密，这样即使数据被盗，黑客也无法读取。

example.t: Engineers use powerful software to simulate the effects of a major earthquake on tall buildings.
example.zh: 工程师使用功能强大的软件来模拟大地震对高楼的影响。

example.t: There is little empirical evidence to support the claim that this diet actually works.
example.zh: 几乎没有实证证据支持这种饮食确实有效的说法。

example.t: The researchers tested their hypothesis by running the same experiment many times under controlled conditions.
example.zh: 研究人员通过在受控条件下多次进行同一实验来检验他们的假说。

example.t: The spread of the virus showed exponential growth in the first few weeks before measures were introduced.
example.zh: 在采取措施之前的头几周里，病毒的传播呈指数级增长。

example.t: Curiosity seems to be an intrinsic part of human nature from a very early age.
example.zh: 好奇心似乎从很小的时候起就是人性中固有的部分。

example.t: Technicians calibrate the instruments every month to ensure that the readings stay highly accurate.
example.zh: 技术人员每月校准仪器，以确保读数保持高度准确。

example.t: Scientists noticed an anomaly in the data that could not be explained at first.
example.zh: 科学家在数据中发现了一个起初无法解释的异常现象。

example.t: Hospital staff must follow a strict safety protocol when handling highly dangerous infectious samples.
example.zh: 医院员工在处理高度危险的传染性样本时必须遵循严格的安全规程。

example.t: Quantum computers may one day solve complex problems that ordinary machines could never handle.
example.zh: 量子计算机也许有一天能解决普通机器永远无法处理的复杂问题。

example.t: Doctors ordered a series of diagnostic tests to find the cause of her fever.
example.zh: 医生安排了一系列诊断性检查，以查明她发烧的原因。

example.t: The team worked hard to optimise the website so that it loads much faster.
example.zh: 团队努力优化网站，使其加载速度快得多。

example.t: The government decided to deploy extra medical staff to the worst-hit rural regions immediately.
example.zh: 政府决定立即向受灾最严重的农村地区调配更多医务人员。

example.t: The report measures the emission of greenhouse gases from power plants nationwide each year.
example.zh: 该报告每年衡量全国发电厂的温室气体排放量。

example.t: Protecting tropical forests is essential because they support most of the planet's remaining biodiversity.
example.zh: 保护热带森林至关重要，因为它们维系着地球上大部分残存的生物多样性。

example.t: Deforestation in the Amazon has destroyed the homes of countless rare species over the decades.
example.zh: 数十年来，亚马孙地区的森林砍伐毁掉了无数珍稀物种的家园。

example.t: Heavy rain has caused serious soil erosion on the hillsides around the village over the years.
example.zh: 多年来，大雨在村庄周围的山坡上造成了严重的水土流失。

example.t: Building roads through the forest destroys the natural habitat of many rare wild animals.
example.zh: 在森林中修路会破坏许多珍稀野生动物的自然栖息地。

example.t: A single invasive species can damage the whole delicate ecosystem of a small island.
example.zh: 单一的外来入侵物种就能破坏一个小岛整个脆弱的生态系统。

example.t: The main air pollutant in the city comes from old diesel vehicles and factories.
example.zh: 该市主要的空气污染物来自老旧的柴油车辆和工厂。

example.t: Governments must find sustainable ways to produce food for a rapidly growing global population.
example.zh: 各国政府必须找到可持续的方式来为迅速增长的全球人口生产粮食。

example.t: Investing in renewable energy could cut pollution and create millions of new green jobs.
example.zh: 投资可再生能源既能减少污染，又能创造数百万个新的绿色就业岗位。

example.t: Wildlife conservation depends on funding as much as it does on steady public support.
example.zh: 野生动物保护既依赖资金，也同样依赖公众的持续支持。

example.t: The rapid depletion of fish stocks threatens the livelihood of coastal communities all over the world.
example.zh: 鱼类种群的迅速枯竭威胁着全世界沿海社区的生计。

example.t: The tiger is now an endangered species, with only a few thousand left in the wild.
example.zh: 老虎如今是濒危物种，野外仅存几千只。

example.t: Many scientists warn that human activity is driving species to extinction at an alarming rate.
example.zh: 许多科学家警告说，人类活动正以惊人的速度将物种推向灭绝。

example.t: Burning fossil fuels releases huge amounts of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere every year.
example.zh: 燃烧化石燃料每年向大气中释放大量二氧化碳。

example.t: A long drought left the poor farmers with almost nothing to harvest that autumn.
example.zh: 一场长期干旱让贫穷的农民那年秋天几乎颗粒无收。

example.t: Few crops can survive in such an arid region without constant artificial irrigation at all.
example.zh: 在如此干旱的地区，若没有持续的人工灌溉，几乎没有作物能存活。

example.t: Rising sea levels are slowly increasing the salinity of valuable farmland near the coast.
example.zh: 海平面上升正在缓慢增加沿海宝贵农田的盐度。

example.t: The factory was heavily fined for dumping untreated effluent into the nearby river last year.
example.zh: 这家工厂因去年向附近河流排放未经处理的废水而被重罚。

example.t: Workers must wear protective clothing when handling highly toxic chemicals in the industrial plant.
example.zh: 工人在工厂里处理剧毒化学品时必须穿防护服。

example.t: The burning plastic gave off noxious fumes that made everyone in the room cough.
example.zh: 燃烧的塑料散发出有毒的烟雾，让屋里的每个人都咳嗽起来。

example.t: Terrestrial animals face very different survival challenges from those that live in the sea.
example.zh: 陆生动物面临的生存挑战与生活在海里的动物截然不同。

example.t: Pollution from local farms has damaged aquatic life in rivers across the entire region.
example.zh: 来自当地农场的污染损害了整个地区河流中的水生生物。

example.t: The ozone layer protects life on Earth from harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.
example.zh: 臭氧层保护地球上的生命免受太阳有害紫外线的伤害。

example.t: Farmers grow tomatoes all year round in a large heated greenhouse near the village.
example.zh: 农民们在村子附近一座大型温室里全年种植西红柿。

example.t: Reducing our carbon footprint means changing how we travel, eat, and heat our homes.
example.zh: 减少我们的碳足迹意味着改变出行、饮食和为房屋供暖的方式。

example.t: Modern irrigation allows farmers to grow crops even in areas with very little rain.
example.zh: 现代灌溉让农民即使在降雨极少的地区也能种植作物。

example.t: Heavy use of pesticide has poisoned the soil and killed many beneficial insects over time.
example.zh: 大量使用农药毒害了土壤，并随着时间推移杀死了许多益虫。

example.t: The fertile soil near the river allows farmers to harvest two crops each year.
example.zh: 河边肥沃的土壤让农民每年能收获两季作物。

example.t: The region experiences frequent seismic activity, so buildings must be built to resist earthquakes.
example.zh: 该地区地震活动频繁，因此建筑物必须能抗震。

example.t: A rise in global temperatures could have catastrophic consequences for many low-lying island nations.
example.zh: 全球气温上升可能会给许多低洼岛国带来灾难性的后果。

example.t: A new pathogen can spread quickly through a crowded city before doctors recognise it.
example.zh: 新的病原体能在医生识别出来之前，迅速在拥挤的城市中传播。

example.t: The body produces a specific antibody to fight each new virus that it meets.
example.zh: 身体会产生一种特定的抗体，来对抗它遇到的每一种新病毒。

example.t: Doctors removed the malignant tumour before it could spread quickly to other vital organs.
example.zh: 医生赶在恶性肿瘤迅速扩散到其他重要器官之前将其切除。

example.t: The doctor prescribed a drug to reduce the inflammation around her badly injured knee.
example.zh: 医生开了一种药，以减轻她严重受伤的膝盖周围的炎症。

example.t: Patients with this rare syndrome often suffer from extreme tiredness and constant muscle pain.
example.zh: 患有这种罕见综合征的病人常常极度疲倦，并伴有持续的肌肉疼痛。

example.t: The government acted quickly to control the epidemic before it spread to the capital.
example.zh: 政府迅速采取行动，在疫情蔓延到首都之前控制住了它。

meaning_zh: 大流行病；全球性流行病

example.t: A pandemic spreads across continents and affects far more people than a local outbreak.
example.zh: 大流行病会跨越各大洲传播，影响的人数远多于局部疫情。

example.t: Measles is highly contagious, so unvaccinated children are usually kept away from other pupils.
example.zh: 麻疹传染性极强，因此未接种疫苗的孩子通常会被要求远离其他同学。

example.t: Regular exercise can speed up your metabolism and help control your weight over time.
example.zh: 规律锻炼可以随着时间推移加快新陈代谢，并有助于控制体重。

example.t: Every essential nutrient the body needs daily can be found in a balanced diet.
example.zh: 身体每天所需的各种必需营养都能从均衡饮食中获得。

example.t: Making small dietary changes can greatly improve your long-term health over the coming years.
example.zh: 在饮食上做些小改变，就能在未来几年里大大改善你的长期健康。

example.t: A sedentary lifestyle greatly increases the risk of heart disease and other health problems.
example.zh: 久坐不动的生活方式会大大增加患心脏病和其他健康问题的风险。

example.t: Childhood obesity has become an increasingly serious public health problem in many wealthy countries.
example.zh: 儿童肥胖已成为许多富裕国家日益严重的公共卫生问题。

example.t: Doctors warn that untreated hypertension can eventually lead to a serious stroke or heart attack.
example.zh: 医生警告说，未治疗的高血压最终可能导致严重的中风或心脏病发作。

example.t: Fear produces clear physiological changes in the body, such as a faster heartbeat and breathing.
example.zh: 恐惧会在身体上引起明显的生理变化，比如心跳和呼吸加快。

example.t: The psychological effects of losing a job can last much longer than the financial ones.
example.zh: 失业带来的心理影响可能比经济影响持续得久得多。

example.t: Learning a second language may significantly improve cognitive skills such as memory and attention.
example.zh: 学习第二语言可能显著提升记忆力和注意力等认知能力。

example.t: The doctor said the prognosis was good because the cancer had been found early.
example.zh: 医生说预后良好，因为癌症发现得早。

example.t: After months of treatment her cancer went into remission and she returned to work.
example.zh: 经过数月治疗，她的癌症进入缓解期，她也重返了工作岗位。

example.t: Swimming and running are both excellent forms of aerobic exercise for a strong heart.
example.zh: 游泳和跑步都是对强健心脏极佳的有氧运动形式。

example.t: Eating less salt and exercising more can greatly reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease.
example.zh: 少吃盐、多锻炼可以大大降低患心血管疾病的风险。

example.t: This drug is extremely potent, so even a tiny dose can be very dangerous.
example.zh: 这种药药性极强，因此即使是很小的剂量也可能非常危险。

example.t: Gardening can have a therapeutic effect on people recovering from a long, serious illness.
example.zh: 园艺对从长期重病中康复的人有治疗效果。

example.t: Some people have a genetic susceptibility that makes them catch common colds more easily.
example.zh: 有些人具有遗传易感性，使他们更容易患上普通感冒。

example.t: Arthritis is a degenerative condition that gradually damages the body's joints over many years.
example.zh: 关节炎是一种退行性疾病，会在多年间逐渐损害人体的关节。

example.t: The condition is hereditary, so relatives of patients are advised to have regular tests.
example.zh: 这种病是遗传性的，因此建议患者的亲属定期检查。

example.t: Stress at work often causes insomnia, leaving people too tired to concentrate the next day.
example.zh: 工作压力常常导致失眠，让人第二天疲惫得无法集中注意力。
